rules: Never publish a character image without recording its source and license.
For live-action characters, use the actor in the official character costume, not a casual portrait.
Crop the source to the face and a small portion of the neck only.
Store square master images and apply a circular crop in the Android UI.
For animated characters use official recognizable face artwork; for football teams use official crests.

android.image_loading: Use an image loader with centerCrop and circular transformation.
android.fallback: Use the VisionFlix lime-on-dark placeholder when image_url is absent or fails.
android.selection_value: Persist character id and image_url with the selected profile in Supabase.
